title: Add goal-checked action skills and ACT-1 qualification
body:
## Why

An ordinary provider `NotFound` currently becomes `ProvenAbsent`, even though an in-flight operation may still commit. Tool completion and process exit also do not establish the requested business postcondition. Both gaps can produce unsafe recovery decisions.

## What changes

- Keep missing provider status unresolved, with a regression reproduced against the original implementation.
- Add versioned action-skill contracts and an exact-payload invocation envelope on the existing FinalUse and durable TaskFlow execution path.
- Add a goal-checked provider decorator with independently bound initiation, termination and destination evidence. Errors after possible contact remain indeterminate; recovery queries the original identity and never redispatches.
- Separate execution, cancellation and goal states. A controlled destination's persistent rejection tombstone demonstrates a valid Failed result with no possible late commit.
- Add ACT-1 fault injection, three bounded conformance baselines, real stdin/SIGKILL tests, a read-only business oracle and retained native records.

The first commit is the smallest independently useful landing: the `NotFound` safety fix. Contracts, driver, destination, baseline fixtures, integration tests and evidence are separate subsequent commits; each code stage is under 800 changed lines.

## Validation

The final Linux native automation run passed **150 tests**, with two intentionally ignored subprocess helper entry points exercised by parent tests. Scoped `just fix` and `just fmt` passed; the final Clippy log has no warnings. The suite ran on tree `aa2afbb8eaa8b0c4d9e5c3c93abf03fa7cba4951`; the only later code change was a recorded whitespace-only formatting adjustment. Qualification files were added afterwards.

The 30 unique baseline/scenario rows contain 15 actual full business goals, 12 reported successes and 18 UNKNOWN results: **0 false successes, 0 duplicate effects, 30 dispatches and 42 provider recovery queries**. UNKNOWN includes 3 complete goals with unavailable lookup, 6 partial effects and 9 zero-effect cases. The positive Failed test is outside the matrix denominator.

[Qualification, full matrix, raw logs and source identities](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/blob/95617b64dfdb035780f18c20df5f344ace1fc34a/qualification/act1-action-cell-20261108/README.md)

## Scope

This is a controlled single-effect execution-semantics qualification. It does not activate the production Agentd/runtime.codex path, introduce a global durable budget scheduler, establish new-epoch/two-writer recovery, run Bazel/Windows tests, or measure learned hierarchy, neural adaptation or unseen-composition gains. There is no generic exactly-once claim.

The branch starts at `6ddfca2406e4d01416cd2f7ab1655a0dc16f8da5` on `fix/codex-v13-same-model-next-task-20261106`; it is not an integration into main. Failed test/build/setup attempts remain alongside the final evidence.
